title: SEC1: SHA3 function naming inconsistency noted
description: SHA3 functions have naming inconsistency vs SHA2: wc_Sha3_256_Update vs wc_Sha256Update. wolfCrypt has done SHA3 function renames in past versions. Good news: all six switch statements in wolfssl_sha.c have explicit case statements for each SHA3 variant, and all have default cases. Breakage from a rename would be COMPILE-TIME VISIBLE (undefined reference). This is acceptable for solo maintenance. Documented for awareness.
